objective: Carry a frozen complete configured project read boundary through ordinary search, private native ingress and publication without replacing it with latest heads.
requirements: One logical project per configured DB, independent physical write owners and stable session route; foreign projects stay read-only.
Freeze source heads once for the turn before its first search; all later probes and capture use that boundary. Serialize it in PendingTurn so workers/restart do not invent new heads.
Ordinary Handoff reads all physical owners using the exact captured snapshots; complete Work graph matching is not restricted by recommendation rank.
Original native event body is written once; private source projections and background feed imports do not copy Post bodies.
Source ACK binds the exact configured read boundary; no source-only publisher shadows a logical project.
Keep canonical numerical data project/scope-owned; do not introduce one vector copy per client or owner.
Distinct checks for source durability, derived readiness and actual delivered context. Do not claim cross-project transitive closure or sustained 80-user capacity from the small integration fixture.
validation: Lean checks for exact reopening and configured inventory; native normal-path capture/search/save with old retained heads after later publication and process restart.
Retry, missing owner, wrong project/scope, read-only, expired feed, missing Pre and reference corruption; preservation of original bytes, receipt chain and replay output.
Ordinary ContractAudit and resource guard remain required. No paid answering calls before the model-free integration passes.
